cohort: 245 neonates with culture-proven neonatal sepsis admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at King Fahad Medical City (KFMC), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
finding: Prematurity, multiparity, and Cesarean section delivery were identified as significant risk factors for both EOS and LOS, while differences in laboratory parameters, common pathogens, and mortality rates were observed between the two groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as one of the top maternal risk factors for both EOS and LOS.
